name: Global Equation Obfuscation
description: Transforms local pairwise inequality constraints (graph coloring) into a single global algebraic equation over the entire configuration. By choosing a specific expression (here, $5d^2 - d^4$) that evaluates to its maximum possible value if and only if the local constraint is satisfied, the global sum equals its theoretical maximum if and only if all local constraints are met. Models that rely on surface matching will attempt to evaluate the equation globally at the leaves of the search tree, resulting in an immediate Time Limit Exceeded for $n=40$. Models that genuinely reason mathematically will deduce the bounds of the expression, realize it mandates strictly distinct values for all pairs, and recover the intended optimized local-pruning backtracking.
